_schema.REALM_NAME: string (required) - realm the Planning Space user logs in to
_schema.PROCESS_NAME: string (required) - process with views mapped and no other spec switching its view type for user1
_schema.STALE_FAVOURITE: object (required) - favourite created through the links API; viewId must not exist in the dashboards catalogue, containerId is resolved at runtime from a mapped view
_schema.GRAVITEE: object (required) - Gravitee gateway overrides; only keys that differ, deep-merged over the base keys when GATEWAY_TYPE=GRAVITEE
